name: Negativity Bias
definition: Negative information receives disproportionate weight relative to comparable positive information.
boundary: Severity and relevance can justify unequal weights; count alone is not enough.

source_variants.name: Negativity Bias (Olumsuzluk yanlılığı)
source_variants.definition: Negative information taking disproportionate space in attention and memory.
